newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO LOSE GROUND WITH DRAW AT CELTA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO LOSE GROUND WITH DRAW AT CELTA.

text.p: Spanish champions Atletico Madrid lost more ground on Saturday in a scrappy 1-1 draw at mid-table Celta Vigo that left them 13 points behind neighbours Real who play Deportivo Coruna on Sunday.
Daniel Prodan equalised from a corner 10 minutes from time after Celta's Milorad Ratkovic had put the home side ahead with a deflected shot.
Prodan's joy was shortlived. He was sent off a minute from the end for a heavy foul on the edge of the area.
Earlier in the second half Celta coach Fernando Castro had been given his marching orders for insulting the referee after a disputed decision.
